findings.title: Grafana Labs GitHub Codebase Theft — Pwn-Request workflow misconfig → privileged-token theft → 4 private repos exfiltrated → CoinbaseCartel extortion attempt refused
findings.affected_technology: GitHub Actions workflows using pull_request_target with secrets (process-level; Grafana Labs was the named victim)
findings.summary: Pwn-Request workflow misconfig let attackers exfiltrate privileged tokens from Grafana CI runners, pivot to four private repos, and steal source code; canary-token tripped the alarm and Grafana refused the CoinbaseCartel ransom — same primitive as Mini Shai-Hulud Wave 2.

findings.title: Frigate NVR CVE-2026-25643 — config.yaml exec: directive command-injection → go2rtc shell RCE on internet-exposed video-recorder appliances
findings.affected_technology: Frigate NVR ≤ 0.16.3 (network video recorder for IP cameras, integrating with Home Assistant)
findings.summary: Frigate NVR's config.yaml parser passes the exec: directive to go2rtc's shell context without sanitization, enabling admin-or-unauthenticated-if-internet-exposed RCE; patched 0.16.4, two public PoCs on GitHub within hours of advisory.

noted.product: Apple iOS 26.5 / iPadOS 26.5 / macOS Tahoe 26.5 / Safari 26.5 (Full Disclosure 2026-05-17)
noted.summary: Broad Apple multi-OS security update — out of Watchtower scope (mobile / client-only) but noting for fleet-managed-Apple defenders.
Multiple vimscript code-injection bugs disclosed — client-side editor; relevant only where root operators run Vim on production hosts with untrusted modeline/script content.
IMAP SETACL anyone-ACL injection (CWE-284, CVSS 3.1) plus imap-login memory exhaustion DoS (CVSS 4.3); patched in OX Dovecot Pro 3.1.5 / CE 2.4.4 — low severity.

noted.product: Chaotic Eclipse 'MiniPlasma' Windows Cloud Filter LPE PoC (BleepingComputer 2026-05-17)
noted.summary: Fifth Windows zero-day drop in the Chaotic Eclipse spree (after BlueHammer/RedSun/UnDefend/YellowKey/GreenPlasma) abusing cldflt.sys CfAbortHydration; LPE-only and out of scope, but the spree itself is a calibration data point.

Microsoft 365 account takeover via device-code phishing wrapped in legitimate Trustifi URLs to defeat link reputation; tighten device-code conditional access and hunt non-interactive device_code sign-ins.

noted.product: Secret Blizzard 'Kazuar' backdoor evolved to P2P botnet (BleepingComputer 2026-05-16)
noted.summary: Russian SVR-aligned actor transformed Kazuar into a modular P2P-resilient botnet — IOC value rather than vendor-defensive priority.
Server-side request forgery in download functionality ≤ 3.0.97; upgrade if running the Vercel AI SDK on the server.
Three insecure-deserialization RCEs via malicious model files (CVSS 8.8 each) — joins the broader 'ML library trusting pickle/torch.load on untrusted artifacts' pattern.
Unsafe torch.load() of untrusted PyTorch checkpoints (CVSS 9.8) — generic instance of the documented pickle-in-checkpoint RCE pattern.
Unauthenticated DoS via crafted uploads (CVSS 7.5) plus read_api OAuth scope creation bypass (CVSS 8.1); patched in 18.9.7 / 18.10.6 / 18.11.3 — internet-exposed GitLab instances should apply.
Unsafe deserialization of Java objects via HTTP cookie during OIDC callback; patched in 1.5.0.3 — relevant if DataHub OIDC SSO is internet-reachable.

noted.product: 4D Server SOAP + Lobster Pro (Schutzwerk SA-2024-002/005, FD 2026-05-17)
noted.summary: Older 2024 XXE advisories getting their public write-ups — file-read + outbound HTTP via XML SOAP endpoint; niche enterprise software.
Metric injection (StatsD) plus OOB write and NULL-truncation in PKCS12 bindings; niche Perl-ecosystem patches — metric-injection class can poison Prometheus/Grafana dashboards.

noted.product: WordPress AI Engine plugin (PT-2026-41513, CVSS 8.8) + WordPress Backup/Restore plugin (PT-2026-41465, CVSS 8.8)
noted.summary: Two WordPress plugin Critical-class issues published via PT-Security dbugs 2026-05-17 ahead of Patchstack/Wordfence; AI Engine plugin previously had CVE-2025-11749 MCP bearer-token exposure — treat as second-round exposure.
